verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents an in-product AI feature, Compliance Navigator AI™, that gives regulatory guidance tailored to the user's industry and location. It also offers a Compliance Score with recommended actions. However, neither is shown to analyze the user's own entity, license, or tax records, and the Score is not described as AI-generated. missing for 10: evidence that the AI insights are derived from the user's stored compliance data, description of what suggestions the AI produces, depth of documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Compliance Navigator AI™ delivers fast, accurate, and up-to-date regulatory guidance tailored to your industry and location.
understand your current status and see recommended actions
